meta.name: approach-evaluation
meta.description: Research industry standards and best practices, identify viable approaches for a given technical or architectural problem, and produce a structured factual comparison against project-specific constraints. Reports options — does not decide.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较技术方案，输出结构化分析报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个技术方案中基于约束做客观比较
copy.tagline_en: Compare technical approaches and output structured analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need objective comparison of technical approaches against project constraints

howto.what: 当 Claude 遇到技术选型问题时，它会搜索行业标准和最佳实践，找出 2–3 种可行方案，然后生成一个结构化的对比表，列出每个方案的评价依据、权衡和不确定性，只报告事实，不做推荐。
howto.when: 当你提出一个技术问题，存在多个可行的方案且最佳选择不明显，或者你首次引入某项技术、需要评估行业标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我比较 React、Vue 和 Svelte 在项目中的适用性。
say.note: Claude 会调研并按标准输出对比表。

say.text: 评估一下用 PostgreSQL 还是 MongoDB 存储用户数据。
say.note: 会从项目上下文提取约束后对比。

say.text: 分析使用微服务与单体架构的利弊。
say.note: 会生成权衡列表，但不替你做决定。

howto.what_en: When Claude encounters a technical decision point, it researches industry standards, identifies 2-3 viable approaches, and produces a structured comparison with factual evidence, trade-offs, and uncertainties — without making a recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a technical problem with multiple non-obvious solutions, or when introducing a new technology, library, or service for the first time.

say_en.text: Compare React, Vue, and Svelte for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will research and output a comparison table.

say_en.text: Evaluate using PostgreSQL vs MongoDB for user data.
say_en.note: It will extract constraints from project context.
Generates a list of gains and costs for each.
